source_fidelity.counts: Three source enclosures, five generation stages, three numbered user entries, all twelve source label groups and all six meaningful arrowheads are retained. Splitting English labels across lines produces nineteen visible text objects, not nineteen new energy stages.

source_fidelity.layout_only_changes: Station and users are stacked rather than left/right. The station caption moves above its frame and Users moves inside its frame. The source main rightward arrow becomes downward; the source downward wire branch becomes rightward. The main link still enters the shared users frame, and the wire branch remains a branch, never a series step. Border exit position is layout, not a steam-to-users shortcut.
source_fidelity.no_source_omissions: No source box, conversion step, branch, user entry or enumeration numeral is omitted. No invented generator box or additional loss branch is treated as a source fact.

science.thermal_chain: Fuel energy denotes the fuel's chemical reservoir. Steam internal energy is distinct from steam bulk kinetic energy; moving steam drives the turbine and the turbine drives generating equipment to produce electrical energy. The original diagram does not draw a separate generator box, so its omission is not a new scientific assertion that the turbine alone generates electricity.
science.generation_context: Current ZH/EN prose at p0096#6, p0096#7 and p0097#1 identifies generating equipment. The raw motor-shaft wording is explicitly attributed as source wording, not silently endorsed as the generating machine's modern name. No Motor label occurs in the generation frame; Motor occurs only among users.
science.energy_balance: The conductor branch denotes energy transferred to conductor internal energy through line heating. Neither branch width nor box size encodes a fraction or complete energy balance. Missing exhaust/ambient-loss branches are inherited from a qualitative selected-conversion figure; the current p0097#2 prose states that energy not converted into useful electricity leaves in hot exhaust steam and does not disappear.
science.historical_numerics: The source-era 1 kilowatt-hour, over 90%, nearly 600 degrees Celsius, nearly 300 atmospheres, 40%, 60-70%, and 800-plus-city statements remain prose context, visibly attributed there. None is copied into the figure or made a timeless efficiency fact. No new formula or numeral is introduced.
science.users: The three numbered entries are alternative user conversions, not a sequence from motor to heater to battery. Motor mechanical energy and heater internal energy are appropriate selected outputs. The battery entry is considered separately in the shared terminology note.

neutrality_and_no_key_leakage.notes: All visible labels are ordinary English. There are no source-language glyphs, country claims, flags, historical texture, cultural emblems or semantic artwork. The only visible numbers are the source's 1., 2., 3. enumeration. N34 has zero tasks; no answer, choice, numerical solution or keyed annotation is added.

shared_terminology_note.source_battery_label: Both original PNGs explicitly label the storage battery's internal energy; both candidates faithfully translate that label as Storage battery / Internal energy.
shared_terminology_note.modern_physics_interpretation: Internal energy is a broad reservoir that can include chemical contributions; a rechargeable battery stores usable energy through changes in its electrochemical state. The label is not approved as a claim that charging merely heats the battery, that chemical storage is absent, or that electric current is stored.
shared_terminology_note.attribution_and_limit: Source provenance is hash-bound in the frozen pixel inventory, FigureSpecs and this independent report. The current learner captions do not separately explain battery chemistry. This is a source-derived qualitative diagram with broad terminology, not a universal equation between internal energy and thermal energy. No visible battery label asserts thermal-only storage, so a false-physics finding is not manufactured solely because the more specific Chemical energy label would be pedagogically clearer.
shared_terminology_note.classification: Nonblocking terminology clarification in review evidence, not an invented source correction or candidate edit.
